source_finding.title: Native provider failures enter the Agent score denominator
source_finding.claim: Harbor/Pier integrations map every nonzero Agent exit to NonZeroAgentExitCodeError and do not decode native JSON terminal errors. Native settlement treats that exception as a graded Agent failure and never invokes the existing native-client terminal parsers. Captured authentication errors therefore enter valid Agent scores; an error stream at exit zero has the same disconnected parser boundary.

evidence.detail: All nonzero exits raise NonZeroAgentExitCodeError; the Pier sibling does the same at line 348.
The final classifier consumes upstream exception tags, not the actual client error stream.
A synthetic AgentRecord is built from exit/timeout; stdout/stderr and usage default empty.
